## 中文

### 热点设备选择与默认模式

- Windows 首次默认选中本地热点，macOS 默认单网卡；后续记住用户选择。选中模式不会自动启动热点或触发系统授权。
- 热点新增“查看已连接设备”和“确认并设为 PS5”。按当前 Wi-Fi Direct 连接端点约每两秒更新多个设备 IP，由用户在 PS5 核对后选择；不读取 DHCP 租约、不扫描全网、不自动判断设备身份。
- 热点模式必须在本次会话选择并确认仍连接的目标，才能启动本地服务和发起远端操作。以前保存的 IP 不能直接授权。DNS／网页仍监听电脑热点 IP，选出的设备 IP 用于 PS5 通信。
- 重新选择前先停止服务、结束或取消任务。目标断开、地址变化或连接列表超过八秒未更新时撤销确认，停止服务并取消远端任务；不自动换成其他设备。重启热点后需再次确认。
- 新增受限模式设置 IPC，主进程校验目标连接状态和列表时效，并同步中英文界面、README 与详细指南。

### 验证与限制

发布准备运行 `npm ci`、106 项自动化测试和 `git diff --check`。Windows 原生辅助代码编译测试通过。隐藏 Electron 窗口使用模拟连接状态验证双设备列表、选择、重新选择、服务期间锁定及断开后禁用启动；这些检查不等于真实 PS5 或多设备接入测试。跨平台构建和发布后下载校验结果见对应 Actions。

真实 PS5 多设备接入、固件兼容性、客户端 DHCP 下发的网关／DNS、客户端外网与代理隔离，以及 macOS 实机行为仍待验证。PS5 保持自动获取 IP，主 DNS 仍按界面提示手动设置；本版本未实现自定义 DHCP 或宣称 DNS 已自动配置。第三方内核驱动或管理员改变网络可能影响隔离。

现有依赖审计告警包括 `node-forge` 1.4.0 的签名验证问题：[GHSA-86w9-cpqp-85rv](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-86w9-cpqp-85rv)。本应用使用它生成并签名本机证书，未调用受影响的 RSA 签名验证路径；这不表示依赖审计无漏洞。

### 发布包与说明

提供 Windows x64 安装版及便携版，macOS Intel／Apple Silicon 各提供 DMG、ZIP，以及覆盖六个应用包的 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。所有包未代码签名，macOS 未公证。

仅供技术交流和合法授权测试，处理用户自行提供或有权使用的内容。应用不附带第三方 ELF、网页资源、密钥、证书或游戏内容；第三方下载由用户主动触发并遵守其许可。按现状提供，不保证效果；使用者对操作负责，第三方权利归其所有者。服务就绪、文件发送和 PS5 执行成功是不同状态。完整边界及免责声明见 README。

## English

### Hotspot device selection and default mode

- Windows initially selects local hotspot; macOS defaults to single adapter. Subsequent launches remember the user's choice. Selecting a mode does not start a hotspot or trigger authorization.
- Add “View connected devices” and “Confirm as PS5”. Refresh multiple device IPs from current Wi-Fi Direct connection endpoints about every two seconds. Users verify the address on PS5 and select it; the app does not read DHCP leases, scan the LAN or identify PS5 automatically.
- Hotspot service startup and remote operations require a confirmed, currently connected target for this session. A previously saved IP alone is insufficient. DNS/web services still listen on the computer hotspot IP; the selected device IP is used for PS5 communication.
- Stop services and finish or cancel tasks before selecting again. Disconnection, address changes or eight seconds without list updates revoke confirmation, stop services and cancel remote tasks. Another device is not selected automatically; restarting the hotspot requires renewed confirmation.
- Add restricted mode-setting IPC, enforce target membership and freshness in the main process, and synchronize English/Chinese UI, READMEs and detailed guides.

### Verification and limitations

Release preparation runs locked dependency installation (`npm ci`), all 106 automated tests and `git diff --check`. Windows native helper compilation tests pass. A hidden Electron window with simulated connection state validates a two-device list, selection, reselection, locking during service operation and disabled startup after disconnection. This does not establish real PS5 or multi-device association. See the corresponding Actions for platform builds and verification of published downloads.

Real PS5 multi-device association, firmware compatibility, DHCP-provided gateway/DNS, client internet/proxy isolation and macOS hardware behavior remain unverified. Keep automatic IP on PS5 and manually set primary DNS as shown. This release neither adds custom DHCP nor establishes automatic DNS configuration. Third-party kernel drivers and administrator network changes may affect isolation.

Existing dependency audit findings include the `node-forge` 1.4.0 signature verification issue: [GHSA-86w9-cpqp-85rv](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-86w9-cpqp-85rv). The app uses it to generate and sign local certificates without calling the affected RSA signature verification path. This does not establish a clean dependency audit.

### Packages and notice

Windows x64 includes installer and portable packages; macOS Intel and Apple Silicon each include DMG and ZIP packages. `SHA256SUMS.txt` covers all six application packages. All packages are unsigned; macOS packages are not notarized.

For technical exchange and authorized testing of user-provided or authorized content. No third-party ELFs, web resources, keys, certificates or game content are bundled. Downloads require user action and remain subject to their licenses. Provided as-is without guaranteed results; users are responsible for their operations and third-party rights remain with their owners. Service readiness, completed sending and successful console execution remain separate results. See the README for complete boundaries and the disclaimer.
